purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed NYC flight departure and arrival records for 2013, covering scheduled and actual timing, carrier, flight number, origin and destination airports, air time, and distance, to feed downstream analytics on flight performance and delays.
usage: Consumers should treat year, month, day, carrier, and flight together as the row grain and must explicitly handle nulls in dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay, arr_delay, and air_time, which are retained as nulls rather than imputed and likely indicate cancelled or diverted flights.
limitations: Cleanup did not resolve the roughly 3% null rates in dep_time (0.029388), arr_time (0.0307), dep_delay (0.029388), arr_delay (0.032981), and air_time (0.032981), nor the 0.9154% null rate in tailnum; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no deduplication logic was applied, and the grain has not been measured against the live warehouse.
